batch: r300 (21 recipe-item commodities) + batch-8 (8 proxy-debt commodities) = 29
readme: Walled-store capture worklist. These stores are captured through the owner Chrome (Walmart/Sams = __NEXT_DATA__ fetch; Aldi/Fareway = Instacart offscreen-iframe, IN-STORE fulfillment mode REQUIRED - the Pickup/Delivery price is marked up and violates the in-store rule). A new commodity gets ZERO coverage from their scheduled pulls, so every id below needs a human-driven capture. After importing: compare-deals -> diff-board vs out\comparison-<date>.json -> any EXISTING cell that moves is a collision to fix, not noise.
price_mode_rule: in-store shelf price ONLY (audit-price-mode.ps1 enforces it for Aldi/Fareway).
walmart_reducer_emit: The Walmart __NEXT_DATA__ reducer MUST now emit 6 ~~-fields per product: name~~linePrice~~unitPrice~~usItemId~~sellerName~~fulfillmentType. Append to the row string: +'~~'+(p.sellerName||'')+'~~'+((p.fulfillmentType||'').toUpperCase()). import-walmart-batch.ps1 DROPS any MARKETPLACE / non-first-party-seller row (in-store rule; a 3P pool-cue shop was once the 'Walmart price' for Goya beans). 4-field legacy captures still import but warn that the filter could not run.

items.label: Wild Rice
items.note: 100% wild rice only - long grain & wild BLENDS are excluded by rule (mostly white rice, they would undercut the real per-oz).

items.label: Turkey Breast (raw)
items.note: RAW whole-muscle only (bone-in, boneless roast, tenderloin). Deli/lunchmeat and frozen dinners are excluded by rule - do not capture them.

items.label: Dried Guajillo Chiles
items.note: ZERO coverage at all three headless stores - Hispanic-aisle cello bags. Whole pods only; powder/molido is chili-powder.

items.label: Diced / Cubed Ham
items.note: Diced/cubed tubs. Deli sliced ham is the existing deli-ham row.

items.label: Sweet Soy Sauce (Kecap Manis)
items.note: Kecap manis / sweet soy. NOT regular soy sauce (that row already exists).

items.note: 100% wild rice only - long grain & wild BLENDS are excluded by rule (mostly white rice, they would undercut the real per-oz).

items.label: Doubanjiang (Chili Bean Paste)
items.note: ZERO coverage at all three headless stores. Look for Lee Kum Kee Chili Bean Sauce (Toban Djan) or Pixian broad bean paste in the Asian aisle. Do NOT accept a canned chili-bean product.

items.label: Snow / Sugar Snap Peas (fresh)
items.note: FRESH snow / sugar snap peas. Frozen bags are excluded by rule.

items.label: Horseradish Sauce (creamy)
items.note: Creamy SAUCE. Prepared horseradish root is the existing horseradish row.

items.label: Corned Beef Brisket (raw)
items.note: SEASONAL (peaks around March). If a store does not carry it today, record NOT-CARRIED - do not substitute canned corned beef or hash.

items.label: Aji Amarillo Paste
items.note: ZERO coverage at all three headless stores. Goya jar, Hispanic aisle. Do NOT accept Arroz Amarillo (yellow rice).

items.label: Rye Bread (loaf)
items.note: BLOCKED ON UNIT, not on data: 31 rye loaves are already in the FF/Hy-Vee/Bakers files but the commodity unit is each and those rows carry oz sizes, which the engine refuses to convert to a count. A Walmart capture whose size reads each/1 ct WILL price. See RUN-STATE for the unit decision Brad/main session needs to make.
